sentences.en: There are people to whom, null is a positive number.
sentences.zh: 对某些人来说，零是一个正数。

sentences.en: A negative mind will never give you a positive life.
sentences.zh: 消极的心态永远不会给你带来积极的生活。

sentences.en: His speech has a positive influence on all the colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他的演讲对所有同事都有积极的影响。

senses.zh: 积极的；确实的，肯定的；数正的
正面；正片；语原级形容词
